meta.name: version-release
meta.description: Choose and apply the correct semantic version bump for this repository. Use for every user-visible release, before merge when a change set should ship as patch, minor, or major, and whenever package/plugin/desktop version metadata must stay synchronized.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发版时自动算出并写入正确的版本号
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把改动发成新版本却拿不准该升到几点几
copy.tagline_en: Pick the right semantic version and apply it before every release
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're unsure which version number to assign before shipping a release

howto.what: 负责版本发布:读取当前版本,按语义化版本规则把变更归类为 patch(修 bug)、minor(新功能)或 major(破坏性改动),更新所有版本文件,并创建或复用 v<版本> 的 GitHub 里程碑,关联 PR 和相关问题。
howto.when: 每次发布版本、合并前需要决定版本号,或需要同步版本元数据时触发;若用户明确指定版本号,则按指定版本执行。

say.text: 这次改动只是修 bug,按 patch 发布。
say.note: Claude 会按 patch 规则更新版本并同步文件。

say.text: 新增了设置页,按 minor 升级并同步版本文件。
say.note: Claude 会把所有版本信息更新到新版本。

say.text: 把当前分支的 PR 和关联问题挂到 v2.0.0 里程碑。
say.note: Claude 会创建或查找该里程碑并完成分配。

howto.what_en: Handles version releases: reads the current version, classifies the change as patch, minor, or major, updates all version metadata files, and creates/reuses a GitHub milestone for the new version, then assigns the PR and linked issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when releasing a version, before merge when a bump decision is needed, or when version metadata must stay in sync. Explicit user-specified versions override classification.

say_en.text: This is just a bug fix; release as a patch.
say_en.note: Claude applies the patch bump and syncs files.

say_en.text: Add a minor bump for the new settings page and sync versions.
say_en.note: Claude updates all version files to the new minor.

say_en.text: Attach this PR and linked issues to milestone v2.0.0.
say_en.note: Claude creates or finds that milestone and assigns them.
